    Changelog

    Source: NEWS.md

    molpathR 0.2.0

    • Prepared the package for a first CRAN submission.
    • Examples now run on synthetic files written to the temporary directory (mp_example_files()) instead of referring to files that were not shipped; fast examples are no longer wrapped in \donttest{} and the Shiny example runs only in interactive sessions.
    • The BAM example is skipped unless the optional ‘Rsamtools’ package is installed.
    • DESCRIPTION: reworded description, added Language, removed the unused LazyData field and updated the maintainer address.
    • Citation metadata describe the package version instead of a development milestone.

    Changes since 0.1.0

    • Database construction, merging and persistence share typed table and value contracts. Conflicting primary identities are refused; incomplete links remain explicit. Known legacy empty-table and metadata representations are normalised.
    • Actual pathology and XML imports retain patient/sample linkage. VCF integration uses explicit nonreference genotypes and preserves source fields without inventing annotations. Raw FASTQ/BAM data are no longer treated as variant calls.
    • Delimited imports use exact field aliases, support semicolon/tab separation, reject malformed outcomes and retain unrecognised source columns.
    • VCF ID/INFO/FORMAT/sample values are independent of optional typed backends; BAM fields, FASTQ first-n selection and quality values are repaired. Malformed input and command failures are visible.
    • Database writes stage and verify serialisation, with recovery on replacement failure. Loading rejects corrupt objects. Upload dispatch preserves the original filename without retaining a deleted temporary path.
    • Plot and app filters select the same observations; stale selections are cleared and download formats match their contents. Gene survival groups describe recorded variants, without inferring a negative assay from missing records.
    • Small synthetic cohorts work with stable types; generators restore caller RNG and synthetic file dates have an explicit fixed anchor.
    • Development citation metadata no longer advertises the unresolving draft DOI; no release or deposit is claimed for this maintenance version.

    Figures

    • mp_plot_survival() colours groups with the colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito palette instead of ‘RColorBrewer’ Set1 (red and green), marks censored observations with +, and places the log-rank label in the lower-left corner, which the curves usually leave free (a group whose curve falls to zero within the first months can still cross it); the Shiny app draws that label inside the plot area instead of cutting it off at the y axis. The note on genes without a recorded variant is dropped when the plot falls back to one group.
    • mp_plot_timeline() places each label to the right of its event and moves labels that would overlap onto separate lanes. The date axis is sized to the labels as well as the dates, so labels are no longer cut off at the right edge; events that all share one date are drawn in a 30-day window with that date as the only tick. Date ticks show the month and year, and also the day when months would repeat. Clinical events show their value, with its unit when a unit column is recorded; labels longer than 45 characters are shortened. A patient whose events are all undated now gives an informative error instead of an empty panel.
    • mp_plot_vaf_distribution() bins start at 0, so no bar extends below a VAF of 0; several genes are drawn in one panel each instead of overlaid translucent histograms that could not be told apart, and the axis states that VAF is a proportion.
    • mp_plot_variant_landscape() patient labels are larger (8 pt for up to 25 patients); beyond 60 patients, where labels overlap at any usual width, they are omitted and the axis title gives the number of patients. The “Unclassified” legend key only appears when such records are present.
    • mp_plot_cohort_overview() gives diagnoses and sex codes outside the built-in palette their own colours instead of the grey missing-value fill; the age axis states its unit (years).

    Bug fixes

    • mp_search() refuses an empty or missing term with an informative error instead of emitting one warning per text column and returning no matches.
    • mp_read_auto() recognises every survival time column alias that mp_read_survival() accepts (for example pfs.months), so such tables are no longer refused as unrecognised; its error message lists all supported extensions.

    Documentation

    • The pkgdown site inherits the navigation bar of the shared themakR template, which restores the changelog link and the light/dark switch.

    molpathR 0.1.0

    • Standardise the named v5 package logo across README, documentation pages and available application headers, with matching light and dark artwork.

    Bug fixes

    • mp_query_variants() now correctly filters by classification and variant_type. Previously these arguments were shadowed by the columns of the same name during tidy evaluation, so the filters silently returned every variant.
    • mp_read_vcf() now returns an empty result for a header-only VCF instead of a row of NA values, fixing a reversed index range in the text parser.

    Features

    • Initial release.
    • Parsers for VCF, FASTQ, BAM, XML reports, PDF reports, Nexus pathology/clinical exports, and survival data.
    • In-memory relational database (molpath_db) with build, merge, validate, save/load operations.
    • Query engine with tidy evaluation, variant filtering, free-text search.
    • Six visualisation functions: variant landscape, mutation spectrum, survival curves, cohort overview, VAF distribution, patient timeline.
    • Interactive Shiny application with 6 tabs and cross-tab interactivity.
    • Synthetic data generator (mp_example_db()) for demonstration and testing.
